comment: Every id a UI step may use: `.accessibilityIdentifier("…")` under gui/star and `Modifier.testTag("…")` under star-desktop/src/main (Layer 0, plan §6.2.1). Each client's unit test scans its own source. An id both clients carry is in `ids`; an entry ending in `*` stands for a family (the desktop builds those names from a template). `knownGaps.<client>` names the ids that client lacks, with why; an id found on either side that is in neither list fails the test, and so does a gap that has been closed (remove the entry). Ids built at run time, such as `testTag(tag)`, are not seen.
